key_facts: A car hit a motorcycle from behind on Jal Mahal Road near a temple in Jaipur.
The motorcycle caught fire after the impact.
Multiple people are injured at the scene.
The caller requested an ambulance urgently.
summary.final_summary: A severe accident occurred on Jal Mahal Road near a temple in Jaipur, where a car hit a motorcycle from behind. The motorcycle caught fire, and multiple people are injured. The caller requested urgent ambulance assistance, which the call taker dispatched.
